re_line: Jo Yong-won in Moscow days before US-China-Russia summit · AI exam cheating scandal triggers national security review · APEC CSOM concludes in Shenzhen
morning_memo: Kim Jong Un's closest aide Jo Yong-won arrived in Moscow to meet Dmitry Medvedev, days before the first-ever US-China-Russia trilateral summit.
South Korea's presidential office ordered a full AI-cheating investigation across all national certification exams ahead of Thursday's college entrance exam.

bp_locations.name: Yongbyon Nuclear Complex
bp_locations.note: As of April 2026: Enrichment building expansion complete, new centrifuge hall operational. 5 MWe reactor and IRT-2000 both running. Thermal signatures consistent with increased plutonium/HEU production.

bp_locations.name: Sinpo South Shipyard
bp_locations.note: As of May 2025: Hero Kim Kun Ok SLBM submarine exited drydock after 2+ years of fitting-out but was still not operational. New submarine construction begun in separate bay. NK Pro satellite analysis (Oct 20 2026) separately reports North Korea's Nampho Shipyard missed a deadline earlier in Oct 2026 to launch a 5,000-ton naval destroyer, with hull sections visible at two potential outdoor assembly areas. 38 North analysis published Oct 30 documents public display of a vessel described as a 'Tactical Nuclear Attack' submarine. Kim Jong Un inspected Nampho Shipyard on Nov 7 (reported Nov 8 by KCNA), announcing a new warship under construction larger than the destroyer built last year. NK News reported on Nov 6 that North Korea has expanded warship construction to a third shipyard. 38 North published analysis on Nov 11 of the Choe Hyon destroyer and its strategic implications for the West Sea Fleet. NK News identified a second major east-coast naval base project on Nov 13, beyond the Munchon-area site Kim inspected on Nov 12.

bp_locations.name: THAAD Site, Seongju County
bp_locations.note: As of March 2026: All 6 THAAD launchers were redeployed to the Middle East amid Iran tensions. At least 2 launchers may have returned to Seongju by late March 2026. Battery operational status remains uncertain. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Sohae Satellite Launch Station
bp_locations.note: As of March 2026: 2,500 kN engine test stand firing observed. Two villages razed for facility expansion. New seaport and large assembly building nearing completion. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site
bp_locations.note: As of November 2025: ROK Defense Intelligence Agency assessed Tunnel No. 3 is test-ready and a nuclear test can be conducted at any time upon political decision. Site maintained at high readiness since mid-2024. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Tumangang–Khasan (NK-Russia border)
bp_locations.note: As of March 2026: Road bridge construction accelerated, completion target moved to Summer 2026. Passenger rail service resumed mid-2025. Ore and tank car traffic at highest levels since project began. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state. Russian Transport Ministry applications filed Nov 13 for a 14-daily-round-trip Vladivostok-Rason bus route over the new vehicle bridge, with experts noting the service will likely transport DPRK workers more than Russian tourists.

bp_locations.name: Sinuiju–Dandong (NK-China border)
bp_locations.note: 38 North satellite imagery from October 16 confirms trucks traversing the New Yalu River (DPRK-Friendship) Bridge one day after the October 15 official opening, marking the start of commercial vehicle traffic. Daily NK reports (Oct 31) that North Korean trucks have still not joined Chinese cargo trucks on the bridge two weeks after the Oct 15 opening; North Korean transport officials are still preparing vehicles. North Korea-China trade reached $299M in September 2026, the second-highest monthly total in 2026. Kim Jong Un crossed the New Yalu River Bridge on October 24 during his unannounced visit to Dandong. Daily NK reports on Nov 3, 2026 that North Korea is courting Chinese investors to build hotels and shopping complexes in Sinuiju. NK News reports a surge in North Korean delegations visiting China, putting commercial ties in focus. Daily NK reports Nov 12 that Chinese truck drivers who relied on side income ferrying parcels across the new bridge are souring on operations due to tighter customs checks and movement controls since the October opening. Huanghai Automobile's Dandong bus factory announced it is operating at full capacity on Nov 13 following Kim Jong Un's October visit, raising questions about potential vehicle exports to the DPRK.

bp_locations.name: Rason SEZ
bp_locations.note: As of November 2025: Chinese businesspeople re-entry to Rason SEZ expanded. Coal exports through Rason at highest levels in years throughout 2025. Arms export berth also active. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Yellow Sea NLL
bp_locations.note: As of September 26, 2025: 140m DPRK merchant vessel Toksong crossed the Northern Limit Line near Baengnyeong Island, advanced 5km south. ROK Navy fired approximately 60 warning shots; vessel retreated after 1 hour. ROK Marine Corps Commandant Gen. Ju Il-suk stated October 20 2026 that North Korea has made 'various changes' to forces facing South Korea's border islands, with Seoul stepping up surveillance along the maritime border. 38 North satellite imagery published October 29 shows North Korea continuing to install new fencing along its border. North Korean propaganda loudspeakers were visible at two border locations on Nov 4 from Odusan Unification Observatory and Key Observatory in Gyeonggi Province. ROK Joint Chiefs confirmed Nov 6 that a drifting North Korean fishing vessel was spotted in international waters off Ulleung Island on Nov 3 and is under investigation.

bp_locations.name: Yellow Sea PMZ
bp_locations.note: As of January 27-28, 2026: Atlantic Amsterdam (converted oil rig, Chinese aquaculture platform) relocated out of the Provisional Measures Zone to Weihai shipyard following President Lee Jae-myung's Beijing state visit. Two giant aquaculture cages (Shen Lan 1, Shen Lan 2) and 13 buoys remain in the PMZ. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Vostochny/Dunai
bp_locations.note: As of January 2026: Arms shipments slowed due to ice, one Russian vessel (likely Angara or Lady R) visited Rason, docked January 14 at arms export berth. Cargo routed to Vostochny. Since September 2023: 64 voyages by 4 vessels (Angara, Maria, Maya-1, Lady R) delivered approximately 15,800 containers (approximately 4.2-5.8 million munitions) from Rajin to Vostochny/Dunai. This report is over six months old and may not reflect the current state. Russian Transport Ministry applications filed Nov 13 for a Vladivostok-Rason bus route operating 14 daily round trips.

top_stories.headline: Kim Jong Un's closest aide Jo Yong-won leads delegation to Moscow ahead of US-China-Russia summit
top_stories.body: **Jo Yong-won**, secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party and Kim Jong Un's closest aide, arrived in Moscow by private plane on Saturday leading a party and government delegation at the invitation of Dmitry Medvedev, chairman of Russia's ruling United Russia party.

top_stories.headline: AI exam cheating scandal triggers presidential office emergency response ahead of college entrance exam
top_stories.body: Presidential policy chief of staff **Ha Joon-kyung** convened an emergency meeting and ordered a full review of all suspected AI-cheating cases across every national certification exam, with particular urgency given the nationwide college entrance exam (Suneung) scheduled for November 19. The government will deploy thermal-sensing cameras, dedicated AI-device screening personnel at every test site, and a police special team for organized cheating operations.

top_stories.headline: APEC Concluding Senior Officials' Meeting wraps in Shenzhen; ROK pushes AI cooperation and energy supply chain resilience
top_stories.body: ROK senior official **Park Jong-han** pushed for continued progress on AI cooperation and demographic change response as standing APEC agenda items, and stressed energy supply chain resilience for the region. The CSOM also reviewed the Internet and Digital Economy Roadmap implementation and produced final assessments from the Committee on Trade and Investment and Economic Committee.

also_today.body_text: The South Korean conglomerate hopes to extend its AI chip dominance into data center infrastructure across its broader business portfolio.

also_today.body_text: A train struck a minibus carrying North Korean laborers in Russia's Far East, raising questions about which party bears responsibility for worker safety under the forced-labor program.

also_today.body_text: The piece argues that artificial general intelligence could upset the asymmetric deterrence equilibria that underpin nuclear stability with Pyongyang.

also_today.body_text: The expanded mandate places Seoul between its commitment to freedom of navigation and the risk of further provoking Iran, which previously warned South Korea over its naval presence in the region.

us_korea_deals.state_of_play: Steel and aluminum remain at 50% and autos at 15%, both under Section 232. The Section 122 surcharge expired July 24, so there is no baseline reciprocal tariff. Section 301 is now the likely vehicle for any new measure on South Korean goods.

business_economy.headline: Deputy PM Lee Hyong-il convenes economic issues meeting to coordinate price management strategy
business_economy.body_text: Deputy Prime Minister **Lee Hyong-il** chaired an economic affairs roundtable to discuss inflation management, with processed foods and dining costs showing expanding price increases. The meeting came as energy utility fee hike pressure continues from elevated global oil prices.

business_economy.headline: Korea-Turkmenistan Customs Mutual Assistance Agreement enters force; bilateral trade quintupled in five years
business_economy.body_text: The agreement creates legal ground for customs crime information exchange and anti-narcotics cooperation; Korea-Turkmenistan trade grew from $8.9M in 2021 to $45.2M in 2025, with Korean machinery, vehicles, and steel making up 99.9% of exports.

business_economy.headline: Financial Services Commission chairman Lee Eok-won travels to Switzerland, Germany and UK to strengthen global financial cooperation
business_economy.body_text: FSC chairman **Lee Eok-won** is visiting three European countries to pursue an MOU on bank supervisory cooperation with the European Central Bank, as Seoul seeks to deepen regulatory ties with major financial centers.

business_economy.headline: Bond market watches BOK November rate decision as additional rate-hike expectations build
business_economy.body_text: Market analysts are monitoring global conditions and foreign investor flows ahead of the final Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Committee meeting of the year, with rate-hike expectations rising in some quarters given continued inflation pressure.

business_economy.headline: October rent inflation rose 1.4% year-on-year, fastest pace in 3 years 10 months
business_economy.body_text: South Korea's monthly rent and leasehold (jeonse) price index rose *1.4%* year-on-year in October 2026, the steepest increase in nearly four years; Ulsan posted the sharpest regional gain according to the National Data Agency.

northeast_asia.headline: China and South Korea reset ties as Xi and Lee prepare for ASEAN and APEC summit meetings
northeast_asia.body_text: The China-ROK diplomatic reset is framed around bilateral economic cooperation ahead of the ASEAN and APEC summits where Presidents **Xi Jinping** and **Lee Jae-myung** are expected to interact on the margins.

rok_government.ministry: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy
rok_government.action: Fuel price ceiling extended four more weeks; Hormuz tensions cited
rok_government.detail: The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy extended the petroleum maximum price cap for a fourth consecutive four-week period, citing continued Hormuz Strait tensions and high international oil prices; the cap has been in place since March 2026. The minister held a late-night video call with Czech industry minister Havlicek to discuss the Dukovany nuclear project, and both sides agreed to hold monthly ministerial meetings in addition to existing weekly director-general talks.

calendar_watch.headline: Hudson Institute event: US-ROK Alliance Challenges
calendar_watch.detail: Hudson Institute hosts a panel titled 'Overcoming US-ROK Alliance Challenges: Trade, Technology, and China' on November 17.

calendar_watch.headline: Suneung, nationwide college entrance exam
calendar_watch.detail: South Korea's 2027 academic-year college entrance exam is administered nationwide on November 19; the government has deployed emergency AI-cheating countermeasures following the tax accountant exam scandal.

calendar_watch.headline: First-ever US-China-Russia trilateral summit, Shenzhen
calendar_watch.detail: Trump, Xi, and Putin are scheduled to hold their first trilateral meeting on November 19 on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen; nuclear arms reduction and Iran policy are reported agenda items.

rok_assembly.action: PPP lawmaker Park Chung-kwon introduces bill to restrict contact with North Korean residents
rok_assembly.detail: PPP National Assembly member **Park Chung-kwon** filed a bill to amend the Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Act to ban indiscriminate contact with North Korean residents, citing the need to block North Korean influence operations targeting the South.

rok_assembly.action: DP leader Kim Min-seok refers senior committee member Choi Min-hee to ethics tribunal
rok_assembly.detail: Democratic Party leader **Kim Min-seok** received results of an ethics investigation into senior committee member **Choi Min-hee** over remarks at a closed-door meeting, reportedly suggesting President Lee Jae-myung had opposed former President Yoon Suk-yeol's impeachment, and ordered the case transferred to the party's central ethics tribunal, the functional equivalent of formal disciplinary proceedings.

rok_personnel.name: Park Nam-chun
rok_personnel.detail: Former Incheon mayor **Park Nam-chun** (68) was selected by shareholder vote on November 13 as the 11th president of Incheon International Airport Corporation; his inauguration ceremony is scheduled for November 19. The post had been vacant since February 2026 when the previous president resigned before completing his term.

rok_personnel.name: Kim Seong-jae
rok_personnel.detail: **Kim Seong-jae**, National Police Agency spokesperson, was named incoming Blue House Public Safety Secretary, succeeding the first holder of the post which was established in February 2026; he is expected to begin at the Blue House as early as November 16.

social_statements.handle_context: President of the Republic of Korea
social_statements.quote_text: Public officials who have been delegated power by the people must use that power not to gain popularity but to do what is necessary for the state and the people.
social_statements.context: Post on X, Nov 15, on reform priorities and official duties
social_statements.analyst_note: The statement accompanied a push-back against intra-party critics, days before the APEC summit where Lee is to represent South Korea.

official_x_posts.who: Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy
official_x_posts.quote_text: On Friday night I held a video call with Czech industry minister Havlicek and discussed ways to cooperate on the Dukovany nuclear project. I explained that the recent decision to suspend construction-contract negotiations was an unavoidable judgment to complete the project successfully, and reemphasized that we will unconditionally complete nuclear construction on the schedule agreed with the Czech side. The Czech minister proposed that the two countries' ministers hold monthly meetings in addition to the existing weekly director-general meetings, and I readily agreed.
official_x_posts.analyst_note: The minister's late-night call came as the National Assembly is weighing a hearing on the Czech nuclear deal; the Ministry is running weekly ministerial or vice-ministerial oversight meetings on the project.

official_x_posts.who: Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy
official_x_posts.quote_text: On November 13, I decided to freeze the petroleum maximum price for another four weeks. It was not an easy decision. The maximum price system introduced in March has now been in place for nine months. International oil prices remain high, and tensions in the Hormuz Strait and crude shipping costs continue. Above all, I am concerned about the burden citizens would face if the price ceiling were lifted now.
official_x_posts.analyst_note: The Ministry extended the fuel price cap for the ninth consecutive month; Korea JoongAng Daily separately reported the government's decision to expand naval operations toward the Hormuz Strait, the same chokepoint cited as a risk justification.

official_x_posts.quote_text: Ahead of November 17 Martyrs' Day I invited six descendants of independence movement patriots to the Prime Minister's residence. The state has a duty to give proper compensation and honors so that the patriots' dedication flows into their descendants' pride. We have lowered the age for hospital fee reductions for bereaved families from 75 to 65, and from next year we will expand the beneficiary range to at least two generations.
official_x_posts.analyst_note: The statement precedes the November 17 순국선열의 날 observance; the Premier also announced a cross-ministry vice-ministerial meeting for November 16 on AI-cheating countermeasures.

kcna_delta.bottom_line: State media led with the departure of the Jo Yong-won delegation to Russia, framing the visit as an expression of deepening DPRK-Russia alliance relations; domestic content covered welfare and technology topics, with all recent weapons tests remaining absent from internal KCNA output.

korea_world.headline: Malaysia to receive all 18 FA-50M fighter jets from South Korea by March 2028
korea_world.body_text: Malaysia's defense minister confirmed the full delivery schedule for the 18 FA-50M light combat aircraft ordered from Korea Aerospace Industries, with completion expected by March 2028.

korea_world.headline: Czech nuclear deal assembly hearing under consideration amid construction-contract suspension
korea_world.body_text: The ROK National Assembly is weighing a hearing on the Dukovany nuclear project contract after Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power suspended construction-contract negotiations; the MOTIE minister separately assured Prague that project timelines will be met.
